translations.web: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
translations.bsb: Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.
translations.kjv: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
translations.asv: Let us fear therefore, lest haply, a promise being left of entering into his rest, any one of you should seem to have come short of it.
